text:
Alice: Pushed release v2.14.0 to eu1 at 14:05 UTC. Deploybot ran post-deploy smoke and KV probe p95 spiked, small failure fraction but notable latency increase. :thinking:

deploy-bot: postdeploy checks for rollout v2.14.0 completed. smoke: FAIL (kvprobe p95 > threshold in eu1). See snapshot: p95=420ms, baseline=180ms.

Ben: seeing the same on dashboards. Prefill warmup doesn't look fully primed for the new variant.

Carla: FYI there was a prefill backfill job that started ~13:50 and hit the prefill pool hard — could be interference with warmup.

infra-bot: autoscaler note: 2 hosts in eu1 at 90% mem, scale predicate didn't trigger due to recent scheduling change.

Alice: OK — options: A) rollback full rollout for eu1, B) reduce passive kvprobe sample_rate back to previous value, C) hold rollout and bump warmup concurrency / add temporary capacity. Thoughts?

Ben: I prefer B + hold. Changing sample_rate is low-risk and immediately reduces probe load/noise.

Carla: How do we flip sample_rate? Small flag in config service: /cfg/kv/probe/passive/sample_rate

Alice: I'll apply the patch to config service and roll a small canary (3 hosts) in eu1. Dave — can you monitor p95 and errors?

Dave: On it. I'll set a temporary alert: p95 > 350ms for 10m -> slack notify and escalation to #eng-oncall.

Alice: Applying patch now:

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://cfg.internal/api/v1/kvprobe" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CFG_TOKEN}" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"passive_sample_rate":0.05}'
```

deploy-bot: config change deployed to eu1: passive_sample_rate=0.05. Rolling canary applied to 3 hosts.

Ben: re-running smoke wave.

deploy-bot: postdeploy smoke re-check (eu1) — kvprobe p95=190ms, failures <0.5% for the smoke cohort. RESULT: PASS :tada:

Carla: Looks good. No full rollback needed. We'll log this as a mitigation in the release notes: "kvprobe sampling bump caused transient p95 spike; mitigated by reverting passive sample rate."

Alice: I'll update release notes and the change-window doc with a short postmortem and follow-up tasks. Also creating a follow-up to decouple prefill backfills from release windows.

Dave: Created ticket INF-3421 to investigate autoscaler predicate + prefill scheduling overlap.

Ben: ok to close this thread. Thanks everyone — will keep an eye during the next wave. :thumbsup:
